cfp-hero-to-form.statement: Clicking Submit your extended abstract on the conference hero takes the researcher to the embedded abstract form at #apply.

cfp-copy.statement: The conference page states the 15 October 2026 abstract deadline, 31 January 2027 presentations, 30 papers / 30 posters, Best Paper ₹25,000, Best Poster ₹10,000, and the AI-use rejection policy.

flow:conference-cfp.statement: Researchers can read the INV.ENT call for papers in the designed landing visual language, then reach the embedded extended-abstract form from the hero CTA.
